alerts.message: Florida policies must include MM-CP-FL-01 Florida Amendatory Endorsement (MM-UW-CP-2025 4.2).
MM-CP-E310 is mandatory for locations in FL Tier 1 coastal counties (FL-T03) and TX-T01 (MM-UW-CP-2025 4.3).
A location in flood zone A/AE/V/VE must be scheduled under MM-CP-E101 unless a Flood Exclusion Acknowledgment is signed (MM-UW-CP-2025 4.4).

note: Flood claim at an UNscheduled location on the valid FL policy -> expect adjuster alert (R01 exclusion stands)

alerts.message: Flood is excluded (EXCL-FLD, MM-CP-1030 B.1.g via MM-CP-0010 Section B.1). Check for a restoring endorsement.
MM-CP-E101 restores Flood only for scheduled locations and only for COV-A / COV-B (sublimit $250,000, 5% deductible).
